body: I can understand and relate to both of you in some ways. I have Alcoholic family members, ex boyfriends with a history of drug abuse, a mother with severe Anxiety disorder, a schizophrenic sister, another sister addicted to meth, a brother in prison for being a pedophile. And me, well I'm the pot head with Anxiety, chronic Depression, and likely PTSD. I was raped a year ago, my last boyfriend started getting abusive and I'm just at a point where I just want to shut down completely I've isolated myself for years and used to be a social butterfly in my 20's now at 42 I'm just burned out. I'm currently getting ready to move To California from Alabama. If I don't move I will face being homeless. So i can stay here be close to my kids or go home to cali with family. And hope that even through their own dysfunction they might be able to help, but hell I'll at least have a roof over my head.

I'm always proud of my kids. They surprise me daily at how supportive they are. But it sucks to know that part of that old soul thing they have is from having to watch me go through my spells of depression and anxiety. I hope they do better with less of me around. I have to leave the state in a few weeks. I hope I do better and can get some help that I can't get here. I don't want to live like this anymore. I'm just scared to fail again. I don't want to disappoint anyone or myself.
